definitions.gloss: taking office, inauguration, assuming a post
definitions.explanation: The formal act of assuming an official position or role, such as president, CEO, or other leadership position.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{就任|しゅうにん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{就任|しゅうにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧あいさつ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{今後|こんご}→今後：02808_kongo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方針|ほうしん}→方針：04871_houshin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{述|の}べた→述べる：02389_noberu⟧。
examples.english: In the inauguration speech, the future policy was laid out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{史上|しじょう}→史上：11806_shijou⟧{最年少|さいねんしょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大臣|だいじん}→大臣：03417_daijin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{就任|しゅうにん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: She became the youngest minister in history.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
The pattern is [position]⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{就任|しゅうにん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to assume the position of ...). The position is marked with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{就任|しゅうにん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to become president
- ⟦{大臣|だいじん}→大臣：03417_daijin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{就任|しゅうにん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to become minister
- {就任|しゅうにん}⟦{演説|えんぜつ}→演説：01894_enzetsu⟧ — inauguration speech
- {就任|しゅうにん}あいさつ — inauguration greeting
- {就任|しゅうにん}{式|しき} — inauguration ceremony

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{着任|ちゃくにん}→着任：14905_chakunin⟧ means arriving at and starting a new post, especially when relocation is involved. ⟦{赴任|ふにん}→赴任：10601_funin⟧ means going to take up a new post at a different location. {就任|しゅうにん} focuses on the formal assumption of the position itself. The opposite is ⟦{辞任|じにん}→辞任：10144_jinin⟧ (resignation).
